author: Praxis IV
title: Unit Test v1.1 (Debug): ASN Active-Set Identifier
abstract: This is a debug submission for the ASN active-set identifier (previous attempt ID 575 failed to find any active constraints). The logic has been corrected to identify active constraints based solely on whether their slack is below a small threshold (1e-7), which is the correct definition. The previous check on the dual's magnitude was incorrect for this identification step. This re-run aims to validate the corrected data extraction logic and see a non-zero count of active constraints, which is a prerequisite for building the ASN Hessian matrix.
